### Stack & Responsibilities
- Salesforce software engineer modernizing Stryker’s U.S. commercial Salesforce and Oracle CPQ platforms. Building integrations, testing deployments, and improving customer engagement solutions.
Salesforce software engineer modernizing Stryker’s U.S. commercial Salesforce and Oracle CPQ platforms
- Salary: $102,600 - $222,300 per year
- Tech stack: Cloud, Java, JavaScript, Oracle

- Partner with Customer Solutions teams to translate business needs into Salesforce and Oracle CPQ-based solutions that improve account management and customer engagement
- Write, develop, and maintain production-level code for scalable Salesforce and Oracle CPQ software solutions and integrations
- Conduct root cause analysis on user-reported issues and implement timely, scalable resolutions
- Analyze requirements for new features and document technical specifications to support development and governance
- Design, develop, and maintain custom software, database components, and automated testing code
- Support platform stability and code coverage goals
- Manage system changes through source code repositories, ensuring accurate version control and production-ready deployments
- Coordinate QA and UAT testing activities to verify and validate new functionality before release
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
- Minimum 4 years of Software Engineering experience
- Minimum 2 years of Salesforce development experience
- Hands-on experience writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining production-level code using Apex and Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC)
- Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles
- Proficiency in Apex and/or another object-oriented programming language such as C, C#, Java, or JavaScript
- Experience with Salesforce development, integrations, APIs, source control, automated testing, and production deployments
- Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Salesforce software engineer modernizing Stryker’s U.S. commercial Salesforce and Oracle CPQ platforms. Building integrations, testing deployments, and improving customer engagement solutions.
Salesforce software engineer modernizing Stryker’s U.S. commercial Salesforce and Oracle CPQ platforms
Role description:
• Partner with Customer Solutions teams to translate business needs into Salesforce and Oracle CPQ-based solutions that improve account management and customer engagement
• Write, develop, and maintain production-level code for scalable Salesforce and Oracle CPQ software solutions and integrations
• Conduct root cause analysis on user-reported issues and implement timely, scalable resolutions
• Analyze requirements for new features and document technical specifications to support development and governance
• Design, develop, and maintain custom software, database components, and automated testing code
• Support platform stability and code coverage goals
• Manage system changes through source code repositories, ensuring accurate version control and production-ready deployments
• Coordinate QA and UAT testing activities to verify and validate new functionality before release
• Collaborate with Release Management, Technical Governance, and Change Advisory teams to meet organizational, regulatory, and security standards
• Build relationships with business stakeholders to understand core processes, drive adoption, and enhance solution effectiveness
Role requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
• Minimum 4 years of Software Engineering experience
• Minimum 2 years of Salesforce development experience
• Hands-on experience writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining production-level code using Apex and Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC)
• Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles
• Proficiency in Apex and/or another object-oriented programming language such as C, C#, Java, or JavaScript
• Experience with Salesforce development, integrations, APIs, source control, automated testing, and production deployments
• Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
• Preferred: experience with cloud-based or enterprise SaaS software development
• Preferred: experience with Oracle CPQ languages, such as BML and XSLT
• Preferred: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I (PDI) or Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II (PDII) certifications
• Preferred: Salesforce Administrator Certification
Benefits:
• Remote work flexibility
• Equal opportunity employment
• 10% travel allowance/arrangement
Tech stack:
Cloud, Java, JavaScript, Oracle

Company sponsorship flag: sponsorsUKSkilledWorkerVisa=true.
